policyClasses.restricted: Lawful reuse with terms requiring explicit operator acceptance; disabled by default.
policyClasses.gated: Makes no requests until its documented technical and legal gates pass.
policyClasses.blocked: Documentation or official links only; never fetched by TravelCanary.

localConditions.notice: Forecast, not an observation or warning. Open-Meteo and its weather-model providers; hourly data reformatted by TravelCanary.

localConditions.name: Open-Meteo / Copernicus CAMS

localConditions.name: Open-Meteo marine forecast
localConditions.notice: Open-Meteo / DWD and marine-model providers. Nearby offshore forecast. Not suitable for navigation, beach-safety decisions or determining ferry operation.

localConditions.name: MET Norway
localConditions.notice: Fallback forecast, not an observation or official warning. Reformatted by TravelCanary.

localConditions.name: NOAA Aviation Weather Center
localConditions.notice: Observed at the named airport, not throughout the destination. Units converted; not for aviation decisions.

localConditions.name: IPMA weather stations
localConditions.notice: IPMA station observation. Modified: sentinel values removed, units preserved, and mapped only to reviewed representative destinations. Not a warning or destination-wide measurement.

localConditions.name: IPMA seismic activity
localConditions.notice: IPMA regional earthquake context. Modified: limited to the previous 24 hours, magnitude 3 or greater, within 100 km. This display threshold is not alert scoring.

localConditions.name: IGN regional earthquakes
localConditions.notice: Not connected. This source does not contribute monitoring coverage.
localConditions.blocker: RSS event-time and correction/deletion lifecycle need representative current fixtures before activation.

localConditions.name: ARSO hydrology
localConditions.license: Slovenian public information reuse; attribution required
localConditions.notice: ARSO provisional river observation at a reviewed station. Reference-level crossings are factual station context, not an official warning or destination-wide flood condition.

localConditions.name: Office of Public Works water levels
localConditions.notice: Contains Irish Public Sector Information licensed under CC BY 4.0, provided by OPW (waterlevel.ie). Provisional, unchecked station observation relative to local gauge zero; not a flood warning. See https://waterlevel.ie/disclaimer/.

localConditions.name: Rijkswaterstaat Waterdata
localConditions.notice: Rijkswaterstaat current water-level observation at the named station, filtered to published quality codes and NAP datum. Observation only; not a flood warning or destination-wide measurement.

localConditions.name: VMM Waterinfo
localConditions.notice: Not connected. This source does not contribute monitoring coverage.
localConditions.blocker: The live tested group provides rainfall; water-level group IDs, quality codes and geographic mappings remain unapproved. HIC requires separate authenticated access.

localConditions.name: Lithuanian Hydrometeorological Service
localConditions.notice: Not connected. This source does not contribute monitoring coverage.
localConditions.blocker: CC BY-SA 4.0 permits reuse; exact station/river mappings and vertical-reference metadata need review before publishing values.

localConditions.name: Finnish Environment Institute SYKE
localConditions.notice: Not connected. This source does not contribute monitoring coverage.
localConditions.blocker: OData observation queries, quality flags, vertical-reference metadata and exact mappings need a completed live fixture gate.

localConditions.name: Cyprus air-quality network
localConditions.notice: Not connected. This source does not contribute monitoring coverage.
localConditions.blocker: CC BY-SA dataset; local-time/DST interpretation, instrument flags and representative station mappings require review.

localConditions.name: Bulgarian NIMH
localConditions.notice: Not connected. This source does not contribute monitoring coverage.
localConditions.blocker: Experimental daily data need documented timestamps, reuse and exact station-area mappings; daily values cannot imply current flood warnings.

localConditions.name: Fintraffic Digitraffic
localConditions.notice: Fintraffic / Digitraffic. Modified: only current accident-associated roadClosed records, matched by official geometry. Nearby context, not route advice or complete disruption coverage.

localConditions.name: SMHI water-shortage information
localConditions.notice: Not connected. This source does not contribute monitoring coverage.
localConditions.blocker: Informational-message validity and unmodified-warning reuse requirements need representative lifecycle fixtures.

localConditions.name: Krisinformation infrastructure notices
localConditions.notice: Official Swedish crisis information. Modified into fixed infrastructure categories; source prose is not republished. Regional notices do not prove a destination-wide interruption.

localConditions.name: NDW open traffic data
localConditions.notice: Official Dutch road incident data. Modified: only current serious incidents and complete closures intersecting the destination are retained. Not route advice.

localConditions.name: Autobahn GmbH traffic information
localConditions.license: Official public API; factual context only
localConditions.notice: Official German motorway closure or warning intersecting the destination. Fixed factual summary; not complete transport monitoring or route advice.

localConditions.name: Electricity Authority of Cyprus
localConditions.license: Official free public information; factual context only
localConditions.notice: Official current faults and scheduled interruptions mapped only by reviewed locality names. The list may not represent every premises-level outage.
localConditions.blocker: The five public district pages did not complete within the reviewed eight-second source budget during the release live gate.

localConditions.name: Enemalta live outage map
localConditions.license: Official public outage map; factual context only
localConditions.notice: Official current and planned electricity interruptions matched by published geometry. Fixed factual summary; absence from the map is not an all-clear.
localConditions.blocker: The official planned-outage response was 1,209,931 bytes at the release live gate, exceeding the approved 512 KiB response limit.

localConditions.name: PSE Energy Compass
localConditions.notice: National electricity-use recommendation from PSE. This describes system conditions and does not indicate a local power outage.
